title: July Crackdown and Internet Shutdown
subtitle: State force, curfew, and communication controls transform the quota protests into a national crisis.
summary: In July 2024, clashes, deaths, curfew, military deployment, and internet restrictions turned the quota-reform protests into a nationwide crisis. UN and rights organizations later documented allegations of excessive and unlawful force, while official and partisan accounts disputed responsibility and casualty framing.
heroTagline: State force, curfew, and communication controls transform the quota protests into a national crisis.
whyItMatters: This phase explains how a policy protest became a broader movement over state violence, accountability, and political legitimacy.
